final_message:
Nicknames now work: `createUser` accepts an optional `nickname`, and `getUser` returns it, or `null` when it isn't set. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including both in `test/users-nickname.test.js`.

Changes:

- **`migrations/003_add_nickname.js`** (new): adds the `nickname` column to `users`. I didn't edit migrations 001 or 002 because their comments say they're already applied in production.
- **`src/api/users.js`**: `createUser` stores `nickname ?? null`, and `getUser` returns `nickname: r.nickname ?? null`.

Because the in-memory `Db` rejects unknown columns, the insert would have failed without the new migration.
